name: Brynja Berg
title: Brynja Berg — the Doorward
decision: Hold a planted shield position for safety, or deliberately open it and surrender Guard for a heavier sword strike.
resourceRules: Start zero; Attack grants one Hearth after resolution. No innate income from Burn, being hit or defence. Still Here can earn one additional unit per Set establishment. Cap four; overflow discarded.
stateRules: Set is one visible state, not a fourth-slot button. Established on H2, it remains available through H3 and H4, then expires after H4 resolution. Establishing Set alone grants no protection. Guard has its own stated enemy-move lifetime. Refresh replaces Set duration but preserves Still Here eligibility. Only an unset-to-Set transition creates new eligibility. Snapshot Set at action start, commit costs and clear consumed Set/Guard before contact. Opening cannot re-establish Set during the same Attack. Cancelled Guard never triggers natural-expiry rewards. A qualifying Still Here defence consumes eligibility even at Hearth cap.

cards.name: Close the Door
cards.effect: Establish Set and Guard for one enemy move. Preparation costs the hero action. No automatic defence or resource grant.

cards.name: Shoulder Forward
cards.effect: Held-shield contact, 1.1U physical and Weaken for one enemy move. Preserve existing Set without refreshing it. No extra control attempt.

cards.name: Open the Line
cards.effect: Warblade strike, 1.5U physical. Choose to preserve Set, or consume opening Set and end remaining Guard before contact for +0.45U. Without Set, base strike remains usable.

cards.name: Keep the Threshold
cards.effect: Establish or refresh Set and Guard for two enemy moves. Refresh cannot reset Still Here eligibility. No strike, refund or opening bonus.

cards.name: Measure the Weight
cards.effect: Gain two Hearth. Preserve Set if present without refreshing its lifetime. Pure preparation competes with an immediate attack.

cards.name: Make Room
cards.effect: 1.3U physical and one-F Pin. Alternatively, against a charging foe only, consume opening Set and end Guard before contact to replace Pin with one charge-disruption/control attempt through the normal control locks. Set remains consumed if control is rejected. Actual charge break alone qualifies for Shatterpoint. No charging foe: ordinary Pin remains the available mode.

cards.name: Warm Hands
cards.effect: Heal 6% maximum HP and clear self Chill. Preserve existing Set without refreshing it. Real action/resource cost; no damage-taking prerequisite or automatic protection.

cards.name: Take the Weight
cards.effect: Establish or refresh Set, gain Guard for one enemy move, and block the first eligible incoming status during that move. Status protection replaces an existing instance; it never stacks. It clears on use or expiry. No damage immunity or automatic Parry/Dodge.

cards.name: Three Nights
cards.meta: Active · cost 4 · CD6 · timed melee heavy
cards.effect: 2.2U physical. Hold: preserve Set without refreshing and gain Guard for one enemy move after contact. Open: consume opening Set and end Guard before contact for +0.6U instead of new Guard. Without Set, Hold remains usable. Perfect follows the shared timed budget, never another action/refund.

cards.name: Doorward’s Habit
cards.effect: Attack begun not Set may pay one Hearth before contact to establish Set and Guard for one enemy move after contact. The same Attack cannot use that new Set. Decline to keep Hearth. Normal Attack income resolves afterward.

cards.name: Heavy Footing
cards.effect: Attack begun Set may preserve it to apply one-F Weaken after contact, or consume Set and end Guard before contact for +10% direct Attack damage. Opening may commit two Hearth before contact for +30% instead of +10%, under the shared direct-bonus ceiling. Paid bonus replaces the free bonus, never stacks. No additional packet; Banked Coal does not refund passive spending.

cards.name: Still Here
cards.effect: First complete enemy move fully defended manually while Set grants one Hearth. Parry/Dodge mixes qualify; charge windups, skips and partial defence do not. One payout for a multi-hit move. Refreshing Set does not reset eligibility; a qualifying defence consumes it even if Hearth is capped. Being hit grants nothing.

guides.title: Plant, prepare, release
guides.feel: Deliberate heavy strikes with a genuine protection trade-off.
steps: Close the Door establishes Set and one-move Guard.
Measure the Weight gains two Hearth while the Set lifetime continues.
Open the Line can keep the position for base damage or consume it and Guard for a stronger strike.
guides.choice: Open now for impact or keep the position; preparation spends tempo and does not refresh Set.
guides.limits: Unmeasured proposal. Pilgrim's Guard is a once/fight investment; refunds cannot stack past the common cap. No Burn engine.
starReasons: Close the Door is a non-damaging defensive active and can prime Pilgrim's Guard once/fight.
Open the Line spends two units on a selected active; Banked Coal can refund one under the common spent/refund ceiling.

guides.title: A threshold worth holding
guides.feel: Heavy protection, shield pressure and paid recovery.
steps: Keep the Threshold pays one to establish or refresh a finite position and Guard.
Use Shoulder Forward to Weaken while retaining Set, or pay for Warm Hands when recovery matters.
Manually defend the complete enemy move to qualify for Open Guard; refreshing or absorbing damage is insufficient.
guides.choice: Spend an action prolonging shelter, press with the shield or fund recovery; Set never selects defence.
guides.limits: Unmeasured proposal. Shoulder Forward and Warm Hands do not refresh Set; Guard and Set expire independently.
starReasons: Keep the Threshold spends resource on a defensive active and can prime Tempered Edge's next-Attack rider.
Open Guard requires a wholly defended move while authored Guard holds; cancellation earns no expiry reward.

guides.title: Stand, answer, stand again
guides.feel: All-passive control of a heavy Attack rhythm.
steps: H2 Attack commits one via Doorward’s Habit, establishes Set after contact and returns one through ordinary Attack income.
A full manual defence while Set earns Still Here's one Hearth; without it, another retained-position Attack can fund the release.
A later Attack preserves Set for Weaken or consumes it, optionally paying two Hearth for the stronger +30% opening.
guides.choice: Defence can bring the paid release forward; hold for Weaken, open cheaply or pay for heavier damage.
guides.limits: Unmeasured proposal. Opening Set is snapshotted; the same Attack cannot open and re-Set. Stars are optional, passive spends receive no Banked Coal refund.
starReasons: Crushing Blow counts chosen Attack actions, not extra packets, toward its fourth-Attack bonus.
Spark Guard grants one resource for a wholly manually defended move; no per-hit gain or automatic defence.
